    o.opsregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (t.deliverysuccessrate / 100.0) * (1.0 - t.avgdeliveryhours / 24.0) * (1.0 + t.distributionpoints / 10.0) AS numeric), 2) AS performance_efficiency_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN t.deliverysuccessrate > 90 AND d.invaccpct > 95 
             AND (t.deliverysuccessrate / 100.0) * (1.0 - t.avgdeliveryhours / 24.0) * (1.0 + t.distributionpoints / 10.0) > 3 
        THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS meets_excellence_criteria
FROM operations o
JOIN transportation t ON o.opsdistref = t.transportdistref AND o.opshubref = t.transporthubref
JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry
ORDER BY performance_efficiency_score DESC
